method: TEXT_IGNORE_ACTUALTEXT=2048 bypasses defective PDF replacement tags and reads actual visible glyphs. No PDF modification, guessed glyph substitution or OCR used. Confirmed against original rendered PDF67 and other selected pages.
geometry_note: Page-specific column gutters and adjacency-based same-baseline merging of split inline text blocks; remaining extraction ordering is not exhaustively audited.
remaining_caveat: Some mathematical symbol-font character mappings remain imperfect. Check equations, numbers and figure/table context in preserved original page views.
